label: eq:intro-curve
what: Definition of $E_d$; discriminant $-432d^2$ (sympy) and $j=0$ (PARI) for 40 values of $d$

label: eq:intro-cm-map
what: The map; $(\omega x)^3+d=x^3+d$ (sympy), so it preserves the equation; order 3

label: eq:intro-ap
what: Brute-force point count, minus the Legendre sum and PARI ellap agree for 1366 pairs $(d,p)$, $p<800$, $p\nmid6d$

label: eq:intro-L
what: Definition of $a_m$; PARI ellan equals the product of the local factors \eqref{eq:intro-local} for $m\le2500$, 10 values of $d$

label: eq:intro-local
what: Standard local factors~\cite[Appendix~C, \S16]{SilAEC}; for $0<|d|\le200$ all 1200 bad primes are additive (PARI), $a_p=0$ there; $d=16$ is good at $2$

label: eq:intro-fe
what: Deuring--Hecke functional equation; checked with PARI lfun for 8 curves ($N=27$ to $15552$) at 4 complex points, $\epsilon$ from ellrootno
result: checked against source; PASS (rel err below $10^{-40}$)

label: eq:intro-fe-u
what: $\Lambda^{\rm u}(s)=\epsilon\Lambda^{\rm u}(1-s)$ for the same curves and points (PARI lfun)

label: eq:intro-psi
what: Definitions; $\overline{(4d/n)_6}=((4d)^5/n)_6$ exactly for 2258 pairs, so $\psi_d=\alpha\chi_\bullet(u_d)$ as in \eqref{eq:ud}

label: eq:intro-hecke
what: Coefficientwise in $\mathbb Z[\omega]$: $a_m=\sum b(m_1)\sum_{\N(n)=m_2}n\overline{(4d/n)_6}$, $b$ the local factors at $p\mid6d$ (PARI, minimal model), $m\le2500$, 10 values of $d$ including non-minimal ones
